rules.title: Missing Relationship
rules.description: Required foundational relationship absent for record that declares dependents in pack inventory.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if Pack inventory lists foundation edges but record relationships.items empty.

rules.title: Invalid Relationship Type
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if type not in edge ontology.

rules.title: Invalid Relationship Direction
rules.description: Direction enum invalid or contradicts edge direction semantics.

rules.title: Circular Relationship
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if dependency edge DFS/BFS finds back-edge.
rules.recommended_resolution: Fix edge direction or split concepts.

rules.title: Self Relationship Forbidden
rules.recommended_resolution: Remove self-edge or document approved reflective exception.

rules.title: Weak Type Hiding Foundation
rules.description: RELATED_TO used where Hard foundation required.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if definition presupposes target but only RELATED_TO declared.
rules.recommended_resolution: Upgrade to FOUNDATIONAL_FOR or DEPENDS_ON / Semantic Dependency level.

rules.title: Missing Relationship Strength
rules.description: strength missing when required by schema profile.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if strength absent on official track.

rules.title: Conflict Edge Without Notes
rules.description: CONFLICTS_WITH present without conflict notes/registry entry.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if CONFLICTS_WITH and notes empty.

rules.title: Relationship Endpoint Unknown
rules.description: source/target not found and not marked planned.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if endpoint unresolved and status≠planned.
rules.recommended_resolution: Fix ID or mark planned explicitly.

rules.title: Bidirectional Pair Duplication
rules.description: Undirected relation stored twice as opposing directed duplicates incorrectly.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if RELATED_TO A→B and B→A both present without normalization policy.
